theme_strategy.rationale: Light mode is optimal for legal documentation and service reading, fostering trust and clarity. However, high-contrast dark sections (Hero, Footer, key CTAs) will be used to convey a premium, authoritative, 'Old Money Tech' aesthetic.

headings.usage: Used for all H1, H2, H3 to bring character, authority, and tension.

body.usage: Clean, highly readable, objective sans-serif for dense legal information and UI elements.

colors.strategy: Adapted Luxury & Swiss High-Contrast (Authority, Premium, Depth)

primary.description: Deep Midnight Blue/Slate - Authority, stability, professionalism

rules: Never use pure #000000 or #808080. Always tint greys with blue (slate).
Only use secondary (Gold) for primary CTAs and critical accents to limit 'vibration'.
Ensure normal text meets 4.5:1 contrast, large text 3:1 (WCAG AA).

spacing_and_layout.philosophy: Generous Spacing & High Density for Data

marketing_pages.grid: The 'Tetris' Grid (Mode A) for About Us and Features. Asymmetrical, grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-12 gap-8 to gap-12.

dashboards.grid: High Density Grid (Mode B) for Admin panel. grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-4 gap-4.
dashboards.style: Sharp edges, flat backgrounds, 1px subtle borders (border-slate-200).

rules: Containers with borders must have internal padding (p-6 or p-8) to prevent text collision.
Images must not exceed 80vh on mobile.
Avoid standard Bootstrap columns; use overlapping elements and asymmetrical bento layouts.

marketing.structure: Pure HTML + Tailwind CSS (sections, divs) for creative layout freedom.
marketing.hero: Dark overlay on image (bg-black/50 to bg-black/30). Explicit text alignment.
marketing.marquee: The 'Editorial Ribbon' - slow moving, serif font, huge gaps (gap-24), pale background with dark earthy text for partner logos or service keywords.

interactive.forms: Shadcn Form, Input, Select, DatePicker heavily customized with brand colors and 1px sharp borders.
interactive.buttons: Sharp or very subtle roundness (rounded-sm). Never pill-shaped for this legal brand. Must have hover states: hover:-translate-y-1 hover:shadow-lg transition-all duration-200.
interactive.navigation: Crystal Glassmorphism on scroll (backdrop-blur-xl, saturate-150, 1px bottom border). Must have visible links on desktop.

admin_panel.cards: Cardless or flat minimalist rectangular widgets.

rules: Lenis for smooth scrolling momentum to create a premium feel.
Staggered entrance animations for service lists.
Subtle micro-interactions on hover (opacity, slight transform).
No wild bouncing or spinning; keep it professional and authoritative.

visual_enhancers.textures: Subtle grain/noise overlay on dark sections (Hero, Footer) to break digital flatness.
visual_enhancers.icons: lucide-react with thin stroke widths (1.5) for a sharper, technical look.
visual_enhancers.surfaces: Mix of Flat Solid surfaces for data readability and Crystal Glass for floating navigation/toasts.

hero_background.description: Sleek glass buildings under a bright blue sky (Use with bg-black/50 overlay)

about_us_team.description: Business people signing a contract at a table

services_abstract.description: Lady justice statue with scales and sword

testimonial_3.description: Smiling woman sitting on black chair

page_structure.navigation: Sticky glass header with logo (serif), desktop links, 'Book Consultation' CTA.
page_structure.hero: Full height (min-h-[80vh]). Deep image background, bold Serif H1 ('A Global Platform for Legal Solutions'). Primary CTA and secondary 'Explore Services' link.
page_structure.marquee: Slow scrolling ribbon with key services (Litigation, Arbitration, Compliance, Corporate Law).
page_structure.about: Asymmetrical layout (Tetris mode) combining textual mission/vision and the 'signing contract' image.
page_structure.services: Dense, organized bento grid or accordion list showing comprehensive legal services with a clear pricing hook.
page_structure.booking: Split layout: left side value proposition ('24/7 Support, Delivery in 24h'), right side clean Shadcn form with payment instructions.
page_structure.testimonials: Grid of client reviews with provided portrait images.
page_structure.floating_actions: Fixed bottom-right speed dial or stacked icons for WhatsApp/Zoom/Meet.
page_structure.footer: Massive padding (py-24), dark background (#0F172A), oversized brand text, multi-column links.

guidelines: All interactive elements MUST include a data-testid attribute.
Ensure color contrast meets APCA/WCAG standards, especially text over the hero image.
Forms must have aria-labels and clear error states.
Respect prefers-reduced-motion in all framer-motion setups.

instructions_to_main_agent: Install necessary fonts: Playfair Display and IBM Plex Sans via Google Fonts.
Use raw HTML/Tailwind for marketing section structures to achieve the asymmetrical layouts—do not strictly use Shadcn Cards everywhere.
Build the Admin Dashboard at a protected route (/admin) with a simple password gate (admin123) and dense data tables for bookings.
In the booking form, clearly display the UPI (7992461191@ybl) and PhonePe payment instructions.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic outputs. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Don't make generic centered layouts. Left-align dense text.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur) where appropriate.
You MUST NOT apply universal transition (e.g., transition: all). Add transitions for specific properties.
You MUST NOT center align the app container (.App { text-align: center; }).
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
Every interaction needs micro-animations (hover states, focus).
NEVER use placeholder URLs or AI emoji characters for icons.
Prioritize using pre-existing Shadcn components from src/components/ui.
Ensure all buttons have explicitly set hover text colors.
